page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines with reference marks. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: ac nisi tu benedicas, omnem nostram curam &
industriam, atque adeo tua ipsius dona, nobis
infælicia & noxia esse{a}, Quapropter da ut fidu-
ciam nostram, ab omnibus creaturis auersam
in te solo collocemus{b}.
Quae est quinta petitio ?

l.i: Remitte nobis debita nostra, sicut & nos remit-

main_text.l: timus debitoribus nostris, hoc est, nobis miserri-
mis peccatoribus, omnia peccata nostra, atq;
eam etiam prauitatem, quæ in nobis etiamnum
hæret, propter Christi sanguinem ne imputes{c},
quemadmodum nos quoque hoc tuæ gratiæ
testimonium in cordib. nostris sentimus, quòd
firmiter nobis propositum habemus omnib.
qui nos offenderunt, ex animo ignoscere{d}.
Quae est sexta petitio?

l.i: Ne nos inducas in tentationem : sed libera nos

main_text.l: à malo: hoc est, quoniam ipsi natura adeo debi-
les & infirmi sumus, Vt ne momento quidem
subsistere possimus:{e} infensissimi autem hostes
nostri, Satan{f}, mundus{g}, ac nostra ipsorum ca-
ro{h}, nos continenter oppugnant: tu nos susten-
tes, & spiritus tui robore firmes, ne in hoc spi-
rituali certamine succumbamus{i}, sed tanti sper
illis fortiter resistamus, donec integram tan-
dem victoriam obtineamus{k}.
Quomodo concludis precationem tuam?

l.i: Quia tuum est regnum, & potentia, & gloria

main_text.l: in fecula, hoc est, omnia hæc à te petimus, quia
cùm & rex noster, & omnipotens sis, omnia

page.notes: The asterisk-like printer's mark before "Remitte" is omitted as an ornament, not a word. Marginal references are copied as printed; "Ioa." is given as "Joa." under the i/j rule. "Rom. 27. 3." is printed that way and may be a printing error for 7. 23. The reference line "1. Joa. 2. 1. 2." is printed without separation and is copied as it stands. Left-margin note letters are assigned from the superscript marks in the text; the mark after "esse" is read as a. The sentence "omnia" is continued by the catchword "nobis" at the foot of the page.
